title: fix(mcp): a refused tool argument names the right key without pointing at the protocol upgrade guide, and recordId says it is the id create_record answers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca8Vc6TtxUdTxXSau3

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 工具调用传了未声明的参数时，拒绝信息仍然点名错键并给出正确拼写（`id` → `recordId`、`filter` → `where`），但不再附带「已退役的键请看协议升级指南」那句；六个接收 `recordId` 的工具在参数说明里写明它就是 `create_record` 回答里、`query_records` 每行里的 `id`。
- 为什么改：MCP 工具参数不是协议元数据，从来没有退役过任何键，那句话把 agent 引到一个与它的错误无关的页面；create → update → get 链式调用时 agent 只能靠一次被拒才知道 `id` 要改名 `recordId`。
- 风险与回滚：不改任何参数名、不加别名、不改回答形状（`recordId` 改名与 `id` 别名已在 #17568 被裁拒）。spec 侧只给 `strictUnknownKeyError` 加一个可选开关，默认不变，元数据面的拒绝文字一字不动；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts` 的 `retiredKeyUpgradeGuide`；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `strictToolInput` 与 `RECORD_ID_DESCRIPTION`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-http-tools.unknown-argument-keys.test.ts`，预期 19 个测试全过（新的 6 个在最后一个 describe 里）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32436

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**Refusal text.** Every MCP tool but the dataset pair (`list_datasets`, `query_dataset`, whose inputs are spec `strictObject` schemas) closes its arguments with `strictToolInput`, which builds its message with `strictUnknownKeyError` from `@objectstack/spec/shared`. That factory appended `RETIRED_KEY_UPGRADE_GUIDE_SENTENCE` to every unknown-key refusal, so `update_record` sent `id`, `query_records` sent `filter` and `list_objects` sent `includeSystem` were all told "Keys retired before the previous protocol major are no longer prescribed here — see the protocol upgrade guide". The sentence exists for protocol metadata, where a key whose retirement kit has aged out arrives as a plain unknown key (ADR-0087, 2026-10-26 amendment). Tool arguments are not metadata and none was ever retired.

- `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts`: `StrictUnknownKeyErrorOptions` gains the optional `retiredKeyUpgradeGuide` (default `true`, so every metadata surface is unchanged); `false` ends the message at its fix channels and history.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/protocol-upgrade-guide.ts`: docblock only, saying which surfaces carry the sentence.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: `strictToolInput` passes `retiredKeyUpgradeGuide: false`, which reaches every tool whose arguments `strictToolInput` closes (17, the two federation tools included). `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` are the exception: their inputs are the spec's `ListDatasetsInputSchema` / `QueryDatasetInputSchema` (`strictObject`), so their refusal keeps the spec's sentence, pinned by a CONTROL in `mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts` (head `c10c6e1a`, patch round on contract review 6809454807 S1). The `Did you mean` suggestions (`id` → `recordId`, `filter` → `where`, ...) are unchanged.

A per-key retired table was not built: the kit is deleted one major after retirement by design, so a metadata surface cannot tell an aged-out key from a typo, and reopening that is the #25767 D2 ruling's ground. What is a recorded fact is that a surface never carried a kit, and that is what the option states.

**Record id spelling — no shape change (seat ruling on the card, option c).** `create_record` keeps answering `{ object, id, record }`, the data protocol's `CreateDataResponseSchema`; the six `recordId` takers (`get_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`, `run_action`, `read_file`, `create_upload_link`) keep `recordId`. The #17568 ruling already refused an `id` alias and a `recordId` → `id` rename. Each `recordId` argument's description is now one shared constant, `RECORD_ID_DESCRIPTION`: "the `id` that create_record answers and that each query_records row carries, sent under the name recordId", so the hand-off is on `tools/list`.

`where` is the QueryAST name (`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`), and `filter` / `filters` → `where` were already alias-table entries, so that half needed only the sentence removed.

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.unknown-argument-keys.test.ts`, new top-level describe (6 cases): `update_record` sent `id` is refused (`-32602`, `isError: true`, bridge untouched), names `` `id` → `recordId` `` and does not contain the upgrade-guide URL; `query_records` sent `filter` names `` `filter` → `where` ``, no URL; `list_objects` sent `includeSystem` names the key, no URL; a sweep over all 15 advertised tools: no refusal carries the URL; every `recordId` argument's description names `` `id` ``, `create_record` and `query_records`, and the takers are exactly the six; create → update → get chains on the `id` `create_record` answered and the bridge receives that id on both calls.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.test.ts`, new top-level describe (2 cases): with `retiredKeyUpgradeGuide: false` the full message is the key statement, the suggestion and the history, with no URL; CONTROL, the default still carries `RETIRED_KEY_UPGRADE_GUIDE_SENTENCE` (full-message pin). The existing `strict-object.test.ts` full-message pin on a metadata surface is untouched and green.

## Acceptance notes

- `mcp-server-runtime.ts`'s `agent_prompt` takes an optional `recordId` too; it is a prompt argument, not a tool, and is left as it is.
- `packages/mcp/README.md` lists tool names only, not argument descriptions, so it is unchanged.
